title: Add autonomy summary validator
summary: The autonomous workflow exposes a sprint summary generator, but there is no focused read-only check that its JSON and Markdown outputs remain machine-consumable. Add a validator so routine sprint-summary publication has a stable local gate.
expectedFailureModes: Sprint summaries render for humans but JSON output drifts and breaks machine consumers.
Summary limits or state totals become inconsistent, making published sprint evidence misleading.
The validator writes files, stages changes, commits, or pushes while only checking summary output.
nextAction: Add a validate-autonomy-summary command that checks Markdown output, JSON schema shape, count consistency, limit behavior, and invalid-argument rejection without writing Git metadata.
